coverageNotes: Recognizes three native representation validators; other source fields, complete schema construction and int64 bounds are not measured.

questions.context: Using Convex SDK 1.44.0, a table has required fields `b` (JavaScript number), `d` (JavaScript bigint), and `h` (ArrayBuffer). Each field must reject other value types. `v` is imported from `convex/values`.
questions.question: Which field mapping accepts these native values?

options.text: { b: v.number(), d: v.number(), h: v.bytes() }
options.rationale: v.number() rejects the required bigint in d.

options.text: { b: v.int64(), d: v.int64(), h: v.bytes() }
options.rationale: v.int64() rejects the required JavaScript number in b.

options.text: { b: v.number(), d: v.int64(), h: v.array(v.number()) }
options.rationale: An array-of-numbers validator rejects the required ArrayBuffer in h and accepts an ordinary array instead.

options.text: { b: v.number(), d: v.int64(), h: v.bytes() }
options.rationale: v.number(), v.int64() and v.bytes() validate JavaScript number, bigint and ArrayBuffer respectively.
